mapper.select: select nvl(p.project_status,'NEW') as projectStatus, count(p.chance_id) as projectCount , round(count(p.chance_id)/(select count(chance_id) from prj_chance pp where pp.company_id=#{companyId}),2)*100 as projectCountPercent, (select count(chance_id) from prj_chance pp where pp.company_id=#{companyId}) as projectSumCount, (select count(chance_id) from prj_chance pp where pp.creation_date > (CURDATE() - DAY (CURDATE()) + 1) and pp.company_id=#{companyId}) as currentMonthAppend from ( select nvl(t.project_status,'NEW') as project_status, t.chance_id, t.company_id from prj_chance t where 1=1 and (t.created_by = #{request.userId} or EXISTS (select 1 from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = t.project_assistant and fe.employee_code = #{request.employeeCode}) or 10001=#{request.userId} or EXISTS (select 1 from sys_user_authority_trx suat where suat.user_id=#{request.userId} and suat.document_category='PRJ_CHANCE' and suat.document_id=t.chance_id and suat.authority_source_type='Y')) ) p where p.company_id=#{companyId} group by p.project_status

select c.change_req_id, '第' || c.document_version_id || '次变更' document_version_id, case pc.data_type when 'CHANGE_REQ' then '变更后' when 'HISTORY' then '变更前' end change_type,
case c.change_type when 'CHANCE_ALL_CHANGE' then '全部变更' when 'CHANCE_CREDIT_AMT_CHANGE' then '额度变更' when 'CHANCE_CREDIT_DATE_CHANGE' then '有效期变更' when 'CHANCE_CREDIT_BP_CHANGE' then '全部变更' end change_type_n, c.change_type change_type_code, -- '全部变更' change_type_n, c.status, (select h.description from hls_document_status h where h.document_category = 'PRJ_PROJECT' and h.status_code = c.status)status_n, c.change_req_date, c.change_description, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = c.change_req_user_id) change_req_user_name, (select pq.quotation_id from prj_quotation pq where pq.source_document_id = pc.chance_id and pq.Source_Document_Category='HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' and rownum=1) as quotation_id, #{chanceId} source_project_id, pc.chance_id, pc.credit_flag, c.change_info_desc, c.change_effct_desc,
case when c.status = 'APPROVED' and c.wfl_node_status is null and pc.data_type = 'CHANGE_REQ' then '变更后' when c.status = 'APPROVED' and pc.data_type = 'HISTORY' then '变更前' when c.status = 'NOTICE_APPROVED' and pc.data_type = 'CHANGE_REQ' then '变更后' when c.status = 'NOTICE_APPROVED' and pc.data_type = 'HISTORY' then '变更前' when c.status = 'CANCEL' then '变更作废' when c.status in ('NOTICE_HOLD','SUSPEND') then '变更暂缓' when c.status = 'NOTICE_VETO' then '变更否决' when c.status = 'REJECT' then '变更拒绝' else '变更中' end change_category, c.instance_end_flag
from change_req_info c, HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE pc where c.document_id = #{chanceId} and c.document_category = 'PRJ_CHANCE' and pc.data_type in ('CHANGE_REQ','HISTORY') and c.change_req_id = pc.change_req_id and c.change_type = 'CHANCE_ALL_CHANGE' order by c.document_version_id desc
